entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I... I think I need to return something? A VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'm just so confused by the website.

I can certainly help you with that. I'm sorry to hear you're feeling confused. To get started, can you tell me what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, I don't even know. We had a family emergency right after it arrived. My husband had to be rushed to the hospital for emergency surgery. It was all very sudden.
I am so sorry to hear that. I hope he is doing okay.
He's recovering. The whole thing has just been a nightmare, especially with his deployment coming up. The box has just been sitting here. I just... can't you just help me? I don't know what to do.

Of course. Please don't worry, I can take care of this for you. Let me just pull up your order information. One moment... Okay, I see the VeloBand was delivered 13 days ago. Let me check the return policy for you.
Is it too late? I feel so overwhelmed.

Not at all. I'm looking at our policy right now, and it says you have 90 days from the date of delivery for a return. You are well within that timeframe. We can absolutely process a full refund for you.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you so much, Isaac.

You are very welcome. And listen, I can see here you're one of our VIP members. Given the stressful situation with the hospital and everything you've been through, I've gone ahead and waived the return shipping fee. The pre-paid label is on its way to your email now. I've also added a $25 credit to your account for any future purchases.
Wow. That is... that's incredibly kind. I really appreciate your help today.
It's my pleasure to help. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thank you again.
You're most welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I wish your husband a speedy recovery.
